g.text: Why your mix sounds boxy
Excess energy between 200 and 500 Hz reads as cardboard - small,
closed-in and congested. Boxy is not too much bass; it is too much
low-mid.
the band this diagnostic is about
Low-mid buildup
Too many elements carry energy between 200 and 500 Hz at once.
Cardboard, hollow and congested; detail is hard to hear.
- High-pass what does not need lows.
- Cut 200-500 Hz with a narrow bell where needed.
- Fix one thing at a time.
Masking and congestion
Several parts compete for the same low-mid space.
Vocals sound distant; the mix stops breathing.
- Carve one element, not all of them.
- Compare in context, never in solo.
What the fix writes
3 Frequency A
320 Hz
3 Gain A
-3 dB
3 Q A
Adapted from the "Why Your Mix Sounds Boxy" reference at pauseplayrepeat.com.
You name the symptom. Vibrai cannot hear.
